fusions.name: Through the Rivet Hole
fusions.desc: A precise thrust between the plates that deals 24 damage to a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It leaves the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed Pins
fusions.desc: Looses 3 steel pins at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 15% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Tacked Lining
fusions.desc: Tacks a barrier into your plate that absorbs the next 4 hits, up to 20 damage, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Stitch
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
